format: NDCA Formation team categories, grade, once-per-style and substitutions (future NDCA body profile)

source.registry_document: 2026 June - Compiled Rule Book Master v1 - reduced size.pdf
source.quote_free_summary: Formation categories use either the amateur age definitions or school-grade definitions; members may dance up to the level immediately above their own; Youth/High School teams may not include Adults; every competitor may dance one time only in each style at a tournament; coaches may replace members with reserves for any round, never while the team is on the floor.

requirement: A future NDCA profile must model category definitions, the once-per-style rule (XII.C.6) and substitution (XII.C.7) per member. Studio/Custom has no age categories, no once-per-style rule and no substitution workflow for teams.
enforcement_point: NOT IMPLEMENTED. Future: NDCA profile, per-member checks. The generic Studio/Custom team model (2 to 100 members, no body rules) must not carry it (OD-28 item 9); it belongs to a future body profile.
interpretation_notes: NDCA: no explicit effective date is printed in the supplied PDF (cover: June 2026 edition); effective_from 2026-06-01 is the first day of the edition month and must be confirmed. Re-read 2026-11-23 (XII.C.1, 2, 5, 6, 7). Grade-school age categories involve under-18 members; OD-02 prohibits under-18 at first activation regardless, so a youth formation offering is out of scope.
